name: AI for Small Business article publisher
description: Daily check: publish the next due AI for Small Business article. Continuity posts are every other day; Implementation Tool Stack posts publish weekly on Mondays starting October 5, 2026 through March 15, 2027.
prompt:
Prefer the GitHub Action `.github/workflows/weekly-small-business-blog.yml`, which auto-publishes when the article module exists.

If running manually in Cursor:
1. Read peacemakers-ai/scripts/small-business-articles/batch-schedule.json and find the next articles[] entry where status is not published and scheduled_date <= today.
2. Confirm the module exists (batch7–11).
3. Run: python3 peacemakers-ai/scripts/publish-due-batch.py --deploy
4. Verify live URL returns HTTP 200.

Do not invent credentials. If Vercel deploy fails, report the missing secret checklist.
